property_summary: Invariant: after any token distribution, totalDistributed + totalRemaining always equals totalSupply, because distr() must consume remaining supply; the mutant adds to totalRemaining instead of subtracting, so after any getTokens() call totalRemaining grows and the invariant is violated.
change_summary: Change totalRemaining subtraction to addition, so totalRemaining grows and getTokens' clamp/require logic yields different distributed amounts (hence different balances).
